notes.title: 🚀 Your Superhero Simulator adventure continues!
notes.content: [p]Hello Heroes! 🦸‍♂️[/p][p]We’re excited to share some updates about Superhero Simulator:[/p][p]🔄 Weekly Updates – The game will be updated every week with improvements, fixes, and fresh content.[/p][p]🎮 Level-Based Progression – Your journey is tied to your level! As you level up, you’ll unlock new features, tougher missions, and epic boss fights.[/p][p]🗺️ Mission Balance – Missions will spawn more smoothly as you grow stronger, making your progression more natural and rewarding.[/p][p]👥 Community Feedback – We are closely listening to your feedback and will fix and improve things as quickly as possible.[/p][p]This game is being created with passion by a small team of just 7 people. ❤️ We kindly ask for your patience and support as we continue building and polishing the game together with you.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey – your support means the world to us! 🌍[/p][p]— MightyRaccoon! Studios[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545389/c07b984b67033c87c7727e6de085f475041041e5.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: SuperHero Simulator – Roadmap Revealed!
notes.content:
[p]Hey heroes! 💥
We’re excited to finally share the roadmap for SuperHero Simulator. Thanks to your incredible support and feedback, we’re shaping a city-saving adventure together. Here's a sneak peek at what's coming next:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔥 Q4 2025 – New Skills & Tasks[/h3][p]Your hero is leveling up! We're introducing brand-new superpowers and a more dynamic task system. Every mission will bring new challenges and heroic moments to the city.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💼 Q1 2026 – New Jobs & Cosmetics[/h3][p]Being a taxi driver is just the beginning. Take on new jobs and customize your hero's look with fresh cosmetics. Build your identity both in and out of costume![/p][hr][/hr][h3]👩‍🚀 Q2 2026 – Female Superhero[/h3][p]You've asked for it—and it's coming! A fully playable female superhero is on the way, designed with unique visuals and animations to deliver a fresh heroic experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌆 Q3 2026 – New Maps[/h3][p]The city is expanding! Explore new districts, uncover hidden secrets, and take on even more dynamic events in brand-new locations.[/p][hr][/hr][p]This is just the beginning!
We’ll continue building the world of SuperHero Simulator with you at the center. Keep sharing your thoughts, feedback, and heroic ideas—we’re listening![/p][p]🦸‍♂️ Stay tuned and save the city with us![/p][p]— [b]MightyRaccoon! Studios

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545389/9c81cf9810b2f87b5d5620f0086ca2f36c6db034.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Release Date Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! We’ve decided to push the release of our game to September 18. We’re adding more features, more content, and more fun, all to make sure you get the best possible experience on day one.[/p][p]We’re incredibly excited about what’s coming and we promise it’ll be worth the wait. Thanks for your patience and support! We can’t wait to show you what we’ve been working on! [/p]
